summary: P1 3.1A Schedule Profile Foundation. Adds a stable ScheduleProfile identity and singleton active/default state, migrates the existing schedule into one 'Default Schedule' (ambiguous data aborts; nothing is merged or deleted), and makes schedule resolution and new PlaylistLog provenance profile-aware, failing closed if profile state is ambiguous. /schedule/ is unchanged; no profile UI or minute scheduling yet. Avoid editing /schedule/ while this release installs.
